text.diamond: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
text.pearl: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

text.diamond: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
text.pearl: The shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.

text.diamond: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
text.pearl: Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of water have been mistaken for “moving forests.”

text.diamond: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
text.pearl: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

text.diamond: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
text.pearl: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

text.diamond: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
text.pearl: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

text.diamond: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
text.pearl: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

text.diamond: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
text.pearl: Its wings deliver wicked blows that snap even the thickest of trees. It searches for prey in icy seas.

text.diamond: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
text.pearl: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

text.diamond: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
text.pearl: Usually with a large flock, it is barely noticeable when alone. Its cries are very strident.

text.diamond: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
text.pearl: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

text.diamond: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
text.pearl: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

text.diamond: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
text.pearl: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

text.diamond: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
text.pearl: While its movements out of water are sluggish, it can swim as fast as any FEEBAS.

text.diamond: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
text.pearl: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

text.diamond: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
text.pearl: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

text.diamond: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
text.pearl: Its forelegs have a muscle-based system of generating electricity. Its body shines if endangered.

text.diamond: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
text.pearl: It rests its forelegs on others to communicate with rhythmic electric pulses from its claws.

text.diamond: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
text.pearl: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.

text.diamond: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.
text.pearl: Even while asleep, it maintains a telepathic radar. It teleports when it is threatened.

text.diamond: If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.
text.pearl: When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong ha waves that can ruin precision devices.

text.diamond: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.
text.pearl: Its highly developed brain is on par with a supercomputer. It can use all forms of psychic abilities.

text.diamond: It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.
text.pearl: It is unable to swim against even slow-moving currents. It always splashes about for some reason.

text.diamond: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.
text.pearl: In ancient literature, there is a record of a GYARADOS that razed a village when violence flared.

text.diamond: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
text.pearl: It lives alongside clear ponds. It scatters pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.

text.diamond: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.
text.pearl: The beautiful flowers on its arms have toxic thorns. Don’t even think about picking those flowers.

text.diamond: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
text.pearl: With the movements of a dancer, it strikes with whips that are densely lined with poison thorns.

text.diamond: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
text.pearl: Disliking sunlight, it sleeps deep in forests and caves until sundown.

text.diamond: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.
text.pearl: Once it starts sucking blood, it does not stop until it is full. It flies at night in search of prey.

text.diamond: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.
text.pearl: A Pokémon that gained vastly enhanced flying performance by having its legs turn into wings.

text.diamond: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.
text.pearl: It is impossible to distinguish from rocks. It slams against others in contests of hardness.

text.diamond: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.
text.pearl: It tumbles down slopes, heedless of any body parts chipping off. It eats a ton of rocks daily.

text.diamond: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.
text.pearl: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

text.diamond: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.
text.pearl: It squirms through the ground using its long and rugged body. It always eats while burrowing.

text.diamond: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
text.pearl: It chews its way through boulders with its sturdy jaws. Its eyes can see in the darkness underground.

text.diamond: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.
text.pearl: It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its head butts.

text.diamond: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.
text.pearl: Its skull is as hard as iron. It is a brute that tears down jungle trees while catching prey.

text.diamond: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.
text.pearl: It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.

text.diamond: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.
text.pearl: When attacked, they form a wall with their shieldlike faces to protect their young.

text.diamond: It hefts a GRAVELER repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.
text.pearl: Its muscles never cramp however much it trains. It lives in the mountains away from humans.

text.diamond: MACHOKE’s boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.
text.pearl: It can lift a dump truck with one hand. Using that power, it helps people with heavy jobs.

text.diamond: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.
text.pearl: It can knock a train flying with a punch. However, it is terrible at delicate work using its fingers.

text.diamond: If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting odd powers. It can’t remember doing so, however.
text.pearl: It never remembers using its odd powers, so it always tilts its head in puzzlement.

text.diamond: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.
text.pearl: The flippers of its well-developed limbs give it shocking speed. It is the best swimmer among Pokémon.

text.diamond: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
text.pearl: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.

text.diamond: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
text.pearl: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

text.diamond: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.
text.pearl: It does not keep a nest. It flies over fields and mountains in constant search of floral honey.

text.diamond: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
text.pearl: It spits a white silk that turns sticky when it contacts air. It is used to immobilize foes.

text.diamond: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.
text.pearl: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

text.diamond: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.
text.pearl: When flower fields bloom, it flits around, collecting pollen. Despite its appearance, it is savage.

text.diamond: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.
text.pearl: Encased within its tough cocoon, it endures attacks. It never forgets the appearance of its foes.

text.diamond: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
text.pearl: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

text.diamond: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
text.pearl: It collects and delivers honey to its colony. At night, they cluster to form a beehive and sleep.

text.diamond: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
text.pearl: When endangered, grubs from its six-cell honeycomb strike back. There is only one in a colony.

text.diamond: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
text.pearl: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.

text.diamond: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
text.pearl: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

text.diamond: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
text.pearl: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

text.diamond: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
text.pearl: Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.

text.diamond: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
text.pearl: It is docile as a bud, but turns cheerful when it blooms. It folds back into a bud if sunlight wanes.

text.diamond: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.
text.pearl: It lives along bodies of water. Its body shape has changed to suit its habitat.

text.diamond: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.
text.pearl: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

text.diamond: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It’s strong enough to hurl foes.
text.pearl: With powerful legs and claws, it generates enough power to hurl foes over great distances.

text.diamond: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.
text.pearl: It lives atop giant trees. It wraps its tail around a branch so it won’t fall off while asleep.

text.diamond: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.
text.pearl: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.

text.diamond: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
text.pearl: It tugs on the hands of children to steal them away. However, it gets pulled around instead.

text.diamond: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
text.pearl: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.

text.diamond: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
text.pearl: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

text.diamond: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
text.pearl: It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

text.diamond: This Pokémon’s body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.
text.pearl: A Pokémon born from poison gases. It defeats even the largest foes by enveloping them in gas.

text.diamond: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.
text.pearl: It licks with its gaseous tongue to steal the victim’s life force. It lurks in darkness for prey.

text.diamond: It hides in shadows. It is said that if GENGAR is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees F.
text.pearl: Lurking in the shadowy corners of rooms, it awaits chances to steal its prey’s life force.

text.diamond: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.
text.pearl: It gets nourishment from fear that it absorbs into its red orbs. In daytime, it sleeps in darkness.

text.diamond: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
text.pearl: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.

text.diamond: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.
text.pearl: It appears near travelers to lure them into deep forests. It is said to carry misfortune.

text.diamond: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.
text.pearl: It makes its MURKROW cronies bring it food. It idles its time away, grooming itself in its nest.

text.diamond: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
text.pearl: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.

text.diamond: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
text.pearl: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

text.diamond: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.
text.pearl: It swims at a steady 5 knots. If it senses danger, it will strike back with its sharp horn.

text.diamond: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.
text.pearl: To protect its family, it will fight with its drill-sharp horn. It lives in hollowed rocks in streams.

text.diamond: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.
text.pearl: Its whiskers make a superb radar. They are used to locate prey, even in the murkiest of water.

text.diamond: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting off tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.
text.pearl: As a result of causing tremors by thrashing about, it developed the ability to foretell real quakes.

text.diamond: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
text.pearl: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.

text.diamond: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.
text.pearl: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

text.diamond: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
text.pearl: It sprays a nose-curling, stinky fluid from its rear to repel attackers.

text.diamond: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
text.pearl: It sprays a stinky fluid from its tail. The fluid smells worse the longer it is allowed to fester.

text.diamond: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
text.pearl: It never misses its daily yoga workouts, and it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

text.diamond: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.
text.pearl: Through daily meditation, it hones its spiritual power. It can sense what others are thinking.

text.diamond: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.
text.pearl: X-ray photos were taken to check its body structure. Nothing appeared, however.

text.diamond: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.
text.pearl: It can summon rain clouds. People long ago revered it as the bringer of plentiful harvests.

text.diamond: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.
text.pearl: Its legs grow strong while it chases after its parent. It runs in fields and mountains all day.

text.diamond: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.
text.pearl: It has astounding acceleration. From a standstill, it can reach top speed within 10 steps.

text.diamond: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.
text.pearl: It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.

text.diamond: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.
text.pearl: It stands along paths pretending to be a tree. If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.

text.diamond: It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
text.pearl: It likes places where people gather. It mimics foes to confuse them, then makes its getaway.

text.diamond: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.
text.pearl: Emanations from its fingertips solidify the air into invisible walls that repel even harsh attacks.

text.diamond: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.
text.pearl: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.

text.diamond: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.
text.pearl: It lays several eggs a day and won’t share them with those who have evil in their hearts.

text.diamond: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.
text.pearl: It is a Pokémon that delivers happiness. Eating its egg is said to make one kind to everyone.

text.diamond: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.
text.pearl: Many appear when the night skies are filled with shooting stars. They disappear with sunrise.

text.diamond: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.
text.pearl: It flies using the wings on its back to collect moonlight. This Pokémon is difficult to find.

text.diamond: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.
text.pearl: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

text.diamond: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
text.pearl: It keeps rhythm by flicking its tail feathers like a metronome. It imitates human speech.

text.diamond: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.
text.pearl: It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.

text.diamond: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.
text.pearl: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

text.diamond: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.
text.pearl: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

text.diamond: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.
text.pearl: It switches its standing foot so quickly, it can’t be seen. It cries at the same time every day.

text.diamond: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.
text.pearl: If it flips its head upside down, it’s a sign that it is engaged in very complex thinking.

text.diamond: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
text.pearl: It was bound to a fissure in an odd keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

text.diamond: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.
text.pearl: It once lived in the tropics. To avoid the cold, it lives in caves warmed by geothermal heat.

text.diamond: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.
text.pearl: It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.

text.diamond: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
text.pearl: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

text.diamond: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
text.pearl: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

text.diamond: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.
text.pearl: It stops eating only to sleep. It doesn’t feel full unless it eats nearly 900 pounds a day.

text.diamond: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.
text.pearl: They seem to communicate among each other telepathically. They are always found stuck on walls.

text.diamond: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
text.pearl: Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three mountains and cross two canyons in one night.

text.diamond: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
text.pearl: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

text.diamond: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.
text.pearl: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

text.diamond: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river’s bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
text.pearl: A dim-witted Pokémon. It doesn’t care if it bumps its head into boats or rocks while swimming.

text.diamond: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.
text.pearl: Catching sea winds with its long wings, it soars as if it were a glider. It folds its wings to rest.

text.diamond: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.
text.pearl: It acts as a delivery service by carrying small Pokémon in its bill. It bobs on the waves to rest.

text.diamond: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.
text.pearl: While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn’t need to sleep.

text.diamond: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
text.pearl: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

text.diamond: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
text.pearl: Its huge mouth is almost seven feet across. It has enough power to completely crush a car.

text.diamond: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
text.pearl: Its tail is filled with nutrients necessary for growth. It plays by bouncing on its tail.

text.diamond: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow on river bottoms.
text.pearl: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

text.diamond: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.
text.pearl: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

text.diamond: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
text.pearl: It lives in arid lands. It buries itself in sand and lies in wait for unsuspecting prey.

text.diamond: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
text.pearl: Its body is encased in a sturdy shell. Its head rotates 180 degrees, eliminating blind spots.

text.diamond: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
text.pearl: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

text.diamond: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.
text.pearl: The toxin made in its poison sacs is pumped to the knuckle claws through tubes down its arms.

text.diamond: It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
text.pearl: Hanging from branches using its tentacles, it looks like a plant. It awaits prey, mouth wide open.

text.diamond: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.
text.pearl: It clings to MANTINE to feed on the big Pokémon’s scraps. This is an adaptation to avoid foes.

text.diamond: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.
text.pearl: It obscures its foe’s vision by spitting a cloud of murky ink. It makes its nest among boulders.

text.diamond: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.
text.pearl: The way its two tail fins flutter while it swims has earned it the nickname “BEAUTIFLY of the Sea.”

text.diamond: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.
text.pearl: To avoid detection by predators, it crawls along the seafloor using the two fins on its chest.

text.diamond: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
text.pearl: It drifts in sea currents. Countless fishermen are hurt by its poison stingers.

text.diamond: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.
text.pearl: It alerts others to danger by stridently flashing the red orbs on its head.

text.diamond: It is famous for its shabby appearance. While populous, they tend to cluster in set locations.
text.pearl: It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.

text.diamond: When people bicker, it is said to arise from the depths of lakes to becalm violent hearts.
text.pearl: It is the world’s most beautiful Pokémon. There are many works of art featuring MILOTIC.

text.diamond: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
text.pearl: Scientists discovered that the distinctive patterns on its back differ by region.

text.diamond: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of MANTINE swimming as if they are in flight.
text.pearl: It swims elegantly, mindless of REMORAID hitching on to its broad fins. It has a docile nature.

text.diamond: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.
text.pearl: In the spring, it grows berries with the texture of frozen treats around its belly.

text.diamond: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
text.pearl: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

text.diamond: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
text.pearl: It is extremely vicious and will not stop attacking until its foe is incapable of moving.

text.diamond: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
text.pearl: It sends signals to others by carving odd patterns in frost- covered trees and ice.

text.diamond: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
text.pearl: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

text.diamond: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
text.pearl: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface.

text.diamond: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
text.pearl: It is thought that UXIE, MESPRIT and AZELF all came from the same egg.

text.diamond: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
text.pearl: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when DIALGA was born.

text.diamond: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
text.pearl: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

text.diamond: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
text.pearl: Water makes up 80% of its body. This Pokémon is easily affected by its environment.
